propositions: At bounded-fallback search exhaustion, criterion-banked evidence incorrectly records met=false (absence-of-evidence) indistinguishable from positive refutation, producing false FAIL verdicts

Three-state evidence outcome (met, refuted, insufficient) requires a framework-set evidence_sufficient:false marker riding alongside met=false to signal search-budget exhaustion rather than proven absence
Marker must be written only by the framework (fallback banking path), preserved on markerless met=false re-harvest, and stripped on genuine refutation or met=true to prevent model-tool confusion

All consumer code paths (verdict validation, assembly, finalization, reconciliation, rendering, sidecar payload, close-gate refusal) must emit distinct insufficient-evidence messaging and NOT gate-fail on insufficiency alone
Schema, banking writes, harvest semantics, finalizer re-stamp, and both verdict renderers require coordinated changes to carry and interpret the marker consistently across the consumer graph
